events.title: Open Season Brisbane 2026
events.description: Brisbane's winter music festival continues, featuring an eclectic lineup of local and international indie and alternative artists across various intimate venues. Check the festival program for specific shows and dates this week.

events.description: Experience a special screening of the documentary La Salsa Vive, followed by a tequila sunrise and a free salsa dance class. A vibrant evening blending cinema, music, and social movement for film and dance lovers.

events.title: HSBC Spanish & Latin American Film Festival
events.location: Palace James St & Palace Barracks, Brisbane
events.description: The 29th annual film festival presents a carefully selected lineup of over thirty independent Spanish-language films from Spain, Colombia, Argentina and more. A week-long celebration of arthouse cinema.

events.title: Palace Movie Club Preview Screening
events.description: An exclusive preview screening of an upcoming arthouse film for Palace Movie Club members. A great opportunity for a low-key midweek cinema outing before general release.

events.title: IMA Platform 2026: Emerging Artists Exhibition
events.datetime: Tue 16 Jun – Sun 21 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Annual exhibition showcasing new works by Queensland's emerging artists. Dean Ansell blends digital and AI imagery, while Seren Wagstaff explores everyday regional life through installation and performance. Open Tue-Sun.

events.title: IMA: Mandy Quadrio – Kukunna Murraweena
events.datetime: Tue 16 Jun – Sun 21 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A Commissioners Circle Project exhibition by First Nations contemporary artist Mandy Quadrio. This is a rare opportunity to engage with supported Indigenous art at the free public gallery.
